Senator Investment Group Lp who had been investing in Time Warner Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $72.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.04% or $0.96 $93.14. About 3.51M shares traded. Time Warner Inc. (NYSE:TWX) has declined 3.25% downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.80% the S&P500.
